product_name_specific: C-KLASSE, CLS, E-KLASSE, G-KLASSE, GLC, GLE, GLS, S-KLASSE
risk_description: The vacuum-controlled coolant pump may not be tightly sealed between the coolant and vacuum circuits. This may result in the coolant leaking into the vacuum circuit leading to an electrochemical reaction, increasing the risk of fire.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the requirements laid down in the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of Motor Vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
